newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes down in moderate activity.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes down in moderate activity.

text.p: 1500 GMT - Czech PX50 falls on Friday in moderately heavy trading.
* Overall, turnover 1.2 billion crowns, volume 1,484,218 shares. 194 shares rise, 176 fall, 81 unchanged
The Czech PX50 index dropped slightly on Friday with major issues continuing to plot an uncertain course and many broader issues losing ground.
SPT Telecom lost one crown to 3,370, Ceska Sporitelna fell six crowns to 320, Komercni Banka was unchanged on 2,375 and CEZ was the only high cap gainer, up three to 1,068.
Most attention in equity trading on Friday focused again on investment fund RIF which is quoted on the RPIX index of continuously traded shares.
"The discount in RIF is still around 39 percent so there's still quite a good discount with a very big fund which is quite liquid," said Lubomir Vystavel of ING Barings.
RIF has a market capitalisation of around 10 billion crowns and manages assets worth approximately 17 billion.
SPIF Cesky investment fund, which is also quoted on the RPIX was unchanged at 420 crowns per share.
The RPIX index itself edged 0.3 points higher to close at 1,160.9 in moderate trading.
